lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Four distinct vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the fifth gill slit, arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with longitudinal rows of spots, creating a grid-like pattern with brighter circular nodes at the points of intersection.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible running horizontally along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light on the dorsal edge of the ridge to shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) clustered around the trailing edge and surface of the visible pectoral fin.
